opening.argument: The video promotes BitConnect lending through a direct referral invitation while highlighting claimed returns of up to 1.76% per day. That figure is presented favorably against traditional savings accounts, encouraging viewers to view the lending offer as superior. The creator shows her own credited balance and describes the experiment as ongoing, reinforcing the appeal of participation. Although she briefly acknowledges, “I know it might be Ponzi scheme,” she continues presenting the experiment and its returns, rather than withdrawing the invitation to join.
